cards.title: XY and XXZ Hamiltonians
cards.role: model definition for both figures and the sign-convention review
cards.numerical_form: thermodynamic-limit XY covariance kernel and fixed-magnetization sparse XXZ operator

checks.reason: Both Hamiltonians and all signs are printed explicitly.
a=0 gives the field-polarized XY product state; the printed minus-sign XXX operator has a ferromagnetic ground multiplet.

open_questions: The Fig. 2 XXX curve is described as free-boson critical although the printed overall minus sign makes Delta=1, lambda=0 ferromagnetic and ground-state-degenerate; both literal and intended conventions must be tested.

cards.title: Thermodynamic-limit Majorana correlation matrix
cards.role: clean-room numerical reduction for the Ising and XX curves
cards.numerical_form: midpoint Fourier quadrature for g_l followed by a real antisymmetric 2L by 2L Toeplitz matrix

checks.reason: The paper prints the block Toeplitz form and the complete integral.
The phase ratio has unit modulus away from isolated critical momenta, so physical covariance singular values lie in [0,1].

open_questions: The prose shortcut for critical-Ising g_l is indexing/normalization ambiguous; the implementation uses the unambiguous printed integral and an independently derived closed form.

cards.title: Entropy from covariance normal modes
cards.role: observable for every plotted XY datum
derived_from: orthogonal normal form of a real antisymmetric covariance matrix
cards.numerical_form: positive eigenvalues of iB_L, clipped only at roundoff, summed with stable binary entropy

checks.reason: The paper derives the product-mode density matrix and entropy sum.
nu_m=1 for every mode gives zero entropy; nu_m=0 gives one bit per mode.
Every binary probability pair sums to one.

cards.title: Critical and noncritical entropy scaling
cards.role: independent references and regression checks for Figs. 1 and 2
derived_from: CFT central charges c=1 and c=1/2
cards.numerical_form: declared-window log2 regressions and saturation-versus-correlation-length checks

checks.reason: The paper prints all three scaling coefficients and their regimes.
L and |1-a|^{-1} are dimensionless lattice lengths.
Substitution of c=1/2 and c=1 into (c+cbar)/6 reproduces 1/6 and 1/3.

cards.title: N=20 XXX block entropy
cards.role: finite-chain series in Main Fig. 2 and Hamiltonian-consistency review
cards.numerical_form: sparse exact diagonalization in fixed total-Sz followed by block Schmidt spectra; literal ferromagnetic-sector result is also computed analytically

checks.reason: N=20, Delta=1, lambda=0, periodic summation, and the entropy definition are explicit.
The reduced-density eigenvalues equal squared Schmidt singular values.
A fully polarized member of the printed ferromagnetic ground multiplet has zero block entropy, exposing the stated ground-state ambiguity.

open_questions: Whether the published curve used the opposite antiferromagnetic sign, an excited state of the printed operator, or an unstated Bethe-energy convention must be decided by independent checks rather than by fitting figure pixels.

cards.title: Reduced-spectrum majorization
cards.role: unplotted quantitative claim under scientific review
cards.numerical_form: enumerate product spectra, pad lambda_L with zeros, and test every sorted cumulative inequality for L to L+2

checks.reason: The product spectrum and majorization direction are printed explicitly.
The 2^L product probabilities sum to one.
Padding the smaller spectrum is necessary and preserves total weight before comparing unequal dimensions.

open_questions: The paper does not print the tested L range or numerical tolerance; the reproduction declares both and reports the worst inequality margin.
